limitations: Source audit, not a claim that the stock tuple is qualified.
observed: Source audit for stock Strata v0.1.43.1 and stock OMP 18.10.1, from the v0.1.43 262K slots4-parking profile: only Strata's Windows engine archive and source commit (a0116b2) change; OMP's binaries and source commit (5d0aaff), the IQ3_S pins, the llama.cpp archive and the Python lock are unchanged. The stock setup plan is unchanged (the stock v0.1.43.1 planner gives the identical plan): --max-context 262144 with KV streaming (--kv-resident 32768), --parallel 4 and both stock recommendations (--conversation-cache-mib 8192 and --prefill auto:32768), with the same engine flags, config keys and host floors. Stock setup changes MIN_ENGINE to 0.1.43.1, makes --calibrate with --model tune that installed model (#2036) and trusts a BUILD.json only beside an engine of the source's version (#2054); this profile neither calibrates nor builds locally, and requirements and the planner are unchanged. The v0.1.43.1 changes that reach this profile: the server reads a quoted </tool_call> in a message as text, not as the end of a call (#2026), and recovers a declared tool's JSON call written in a Markdown fence inside <tool_call> (#2037); an engine refusal of a batch slot makes the request try another slot and, after repeated refusals, end in a retryable 503 instead of a permanent 400 (#1994); a prompt chunk that needs more of the prompt loan than the auto chunk's region is lent it, or read in smaller pieces, instead of ending the engine (#2090); the start-up check of the n-gram table's direct reads only warns now instead of switching to memory-mapped reads, which could stall a long prompt's first chunk until the watchdog restarted the engine (#1984); parking a conversation reports progress to the watchdog (#2049), whose disk-read allowance now also measures on Windows and holds while the file tier was busy in the last 10 s; the prompt path's pageable host-to-device copies go through pinned bounce buffers (#1996); and a request warns when free VRAM is very low, with stall reports naming a draft wait (#2065). Windows NVIDIA decode defaults are unchanged: the adaptive overlap stays opt-in (v0.1.43.1 makes it opt-in on Linux too, #2010) and the new host-callback warm-up is Linux-only. Upstream reports answers byte-identical to v0.1.43 apart from a quoted </tool_call>. The host-free suite passes at d2fac61 with this profile's pinned OMP 18.10.1 binary and Strata v0.1.43.1 frontend. This profile has its own root and ledger; earlier tuples remain unchanged.
